name: Shanghai Research Institute of Building Sciences Group Co., Ltd.
summary: Shanghai Research Institute of Building Sciences Group Co., Ltd. operates as a science and technology service company in China. It provides urban construction, management and operation, TIC, planning, architectural design, and engineering survey services; engineering consulting for projects, such as whole process engineering consulting, project management, agent construction management, engineering design and supervision, M&E supervision, agent bidding, project cost consulting, project risk consulting, and BIM consulting; and engineering tests and services in building, transportation, and environment.
